description: Create a cart of SKUs and quantities and return a link (claimUrl) that opens it in the shopper's cart on standardblanks.com, where they review it and check out. It does not take payment or place an order. Give the shopper the link. Limits: 40 lines, $5,000 of merchandise; the link works for 7 days.

sku.description: A variant SKU from get_product (called with a color).

note.description: Optional context for our support team, e.g. what the order is for. Not shown on the cart.

name: build_cart
title: Build a cart link
